summary: The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next QAD drafter runs its MXFP8 experts on B12X again when the image supports it
compatibility: No user action required. Applies to checkpoint revisions with MXFP8 MTP experts, such as qad-step5500-ple1000. Images whose vLLM or B12X lacks the B12X MXFP8 path keep moe_backend auto (Marlin), and an explicit --speculative-config is kept.
details: docker-114 moved MXFP8 MTP drafter experts to moe_backend auto (Marlin) because B12X could not load them. With vllm-957 and b12x-452 in the image, the launcher keeps the profile's b12x for them.
On RTX PRO 6000 TP2 the B12X drafter decodes as fast as Marlin (steps per second within 2.5%, decode tok/s within noise) and accepts slightly more draft tokens (2.34-2.37 against 2.30-2.34 per step).
